state:
Goal `core-request-1-2`: `Core\Request::body` and `Core\Request::bytes` have all their feature proofs.
A proof program answers a request through the `<name>.nvsr` beside it (`docs/examples/README.md` §
*A request for the program*). `bytes` has its card rewritten in the plain voice, a Rust test
(`bytes_answers_a_body_that_is_not_utf8_whole_and_body_still_refuses_it`) and a measured figure.
`Core\Hash` and `Core\Hash\Stream`'s bench figures were re-measured after the `tainted`-argument fix
staled them, so `dossier-core-hash` is green again. The remaining members of `Core\Request (1/2)` owe
their proofs one at a time, in the order the check lists them.

next.note: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/request.rs`, and `docs/examples/core/Request/`, `tests/hostile/core/Request/` and `benches/members/core/Request/`, each with `.nvsr` request files beside the programs:

items.text: **`Core\Request::bodyStream`** — owes examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/request.rs:333`. The Rust tests near `a_body_stream_yields_the_chunks_the_wire_delivered` need only a `// covers:` marker. Rewrite its card the way `BYTES_DOC` now reads. `bytes`'s proofs are the nearest pattern.

**`Core\Request::clientIp`** — owes its proofs (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`; `bun nv proofs --id 'Core\Request::clientIp'`). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/request.rs:369`. A `.nvsr` sets the address with `--CLIENT_IP--` (`crates/nvs-test/src/request.rs:51`).

backlog: A `.nvsr` body that is not valid UTF-8 cannot be written with Write, Edit or `bun nv splice` (its patch format is text only), so `body`'s `ParseError` path and `bytes`'s non-UTF-8 answer have no example or attack. The Rust test covers the octets; owner `nvs_test::request`'s module doc, if a hex body section is ever wanted.

A `.nvsr`'s `content-length` header is not checked against its body under `nvs run --request` (the `bytes` attack declares 1 GiB and reads 62 bytes), so `body`/`bytes`'s "fewer bytes than `Content-Length`" `IOError` has no proof program; owner `nvs_test::request`'s module doc. To see what an attack prints, run `target/covws/<host triple>/debug/nvs.exe run --request <file>.nvsr <file>.nvs`: `bun nv try` takes no `--request`.

`Core\Router::url`/`urlAbsolute` and `Core\Csv::parse`/`format` are still in `UNCLASSIFIED` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`). A proof that passes them a request value will hit the same refusal `Core\Hash` did.
